summary: Choose the unique modal background and initialize the result as an input copy. First, for each color 1 through 9 except the background, compute its original-input bbox; if that bbox contains at least one other foreground color and no background, fill the entire bbox in the result with the color, with higher colors overwriting lower ones. Second, again in ascending color order, if every original cell of a color lies on one row, column, down diagonal, or up diagonal, traverse between its row-major endpoints and repaint only positions whose original input value is not background. This line pass overwrites rectangle fills and lower line colors; original background gaps remain unchanged.
